noEdition.title: No climate COP
noEdition.description: No edition of the climate COP series exists yet. Create it under events.

forbidden.description: Francophonie meetings are managed at global scope. An account attached to a single event has no access.

list.title: Francophonie meetings
list.subtitle: Workshops and consultations offered to negotiators during the COP. A draft does not appear in the app.
list.caption: Meetings of the edition, times in {zone}
list.seatsOpen: No one registered, no limit | 1 registered, no limit | {count} registered, no limit

empty.title: No meeting for this edition
empty.description: Create the first one: it stays a draft until you publish it.

new.title: New meeting
new.subtitle: For {edition}. The meeting starts as a draft; you publish it from its page.

detail.publishHint: Draft: not visible in the app. Publishing applies to the last saved version.
detail.published: Meeting published: it now appears in the app.
detail.cancelled: Meeting cancelled. Registrants see the reason in the app.

notFound.title: Meeting not found
notFound.description: This meeting does not exist, or has been deleted.

venue.label: Venue
venue.hint: Room or building. Required to publish an on-site or hybrid meeting.

link.label: Video conference link
link.hint: Shared with registrants only. Required to publish an online or hybrid meeting.

registration.label: Registration required
registration.hint: Off, the meeting is open without registration to anyone with access.

capacity.label: Capacity
capacity.hint: Number of seats. Empty: no limit.

waitlist.label: Waiting list
waitlist.hint: Once full, the next people wait for a seat to free up.

window.opensHint: Optional, in {zone}. Empty: open as soon as published.
window.closesHint: Optional, in {zone}. Empty: until the meeting starts.

limited.label: Restricted
limited.hint: A designated audience, announced in the app.

audience.label: Audience
audience.hint: For example: ministers and heads of delegation.

ifdd.label: Organised by IFDD
ifdd.hint: Off, choose the organisation holding it.

organizer.searchHint: Name, acronym or former name: every name is searched.

errors.title: The French title is required.
errors.period: The end must come after the start.
errors.capacity: Capacity is a positive whole number.
errors.audience: Enter the audience, in French at least.
errors.organizer: Choose the organisation, or switch “Organised by IFDD” back on.

cancel.title: Cancel the meeting
cancel.question: The meeting stays visible in the app, marked cancelled, with your reason.
cancel.people: No one registered. | 1 person registered or waiting will be notified. | {count} people registered or waiting will be notified.

pavilion.title: Pavilion activity
pavilion.hint: The meeting can extend an activity of the Francophonie Pavilion in the same edition.
pavilion.label: Linked activity
pavilion.empty: No Pavilion activity is scheduled for this edition.

registrants.title: Registrants
registrants.waitlisted: No one on the waiting list | 1 on the waiting list | {count} on the waiting list

empty.title: No registrants
empty.description: Registrations will appear here once the meeting is published.
